label: bitbucket pull request
title: {org}/{repo} PR {num}
prompt: Review the pull request at {url}. The worktree is already on its branch.
notes: The same thing as a github pull request with a different spelling in the path, which is exactly why the host is a field of its own rather than an assumption. No fetch here: fill one in with whatever reads your bitbucket, and the title and branch templates start working.
